Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_temp number;
 szUnitId varchar2(15);
BEGIN
IF :ctrl_block.unitid is not null then
 If Length(:ctrl_block.unitid) in (7,15) then 

 CHECK_VALID_ISBT_OR_CODABAR(:ctrl_block.unitid,szUnitId); --Added by Edwin for iSBt or CODABAR check

 SELECT 'x' INTO :GLOBAL.x FROM donation_interdictions di
 WHERE di.transaction_id IN
 (SELECT transaction_id
 FROM donations
 WHERE donations.unit_id is not null
 AND donations.coll_date between :CTRL_BLOCK.START_DATE and :CTRL_BLOCK.END_DATE
 AND donations.n_audit_flag is not NULL
 AND donations.unit_id = szUnitId
 AND donations.donor_id is not null )
 AND di.unit_id = szUnitId
 AND di.coll_date between :CTRL_BLOCK.START_DATE and :CTRL_BLOCK.END_DATE
 AND di.inter_code IN
 (SELECT code
 FROM valid_master_codes vmc
 WHERE code_type = 'AHOLD'
 AND di.insert_date between vmc.eff_date and 
 nvl(vmc.term_date, di.insert_date+1))
 AND release_date is null
 UNION
 SELECT 'x' FROM donor_interdictions dri, donations don
 WHERE don.coll_date between :CTRL_BLOCK.START_DATE and :CTRL_BLOCK.END_DATE
 AND don.unit_id = szUnitId
 AND don.donor_id is not null
 AND don.donor_id = dri.donor_id
 AND don.transaction_id = dri.transaction_id
 AND don.n_audit_flag is not NULL
 AND dri.inter_code IN
 (SELECT code
 FROM valid_master_codes vmc
 WHERE code_type = 'AHOLD'
 AND dri.insert_date between vmc.eff_date and 
 nvl(vmc.term_date, dri.insert_date+1))
 AND dri.release_date is null;

 Else
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;

END IF;

EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;

END;

declare

BEGIN

 go_item('donations.comments');

 If Length(:donations.unit_id)=15 then 
 szUnitId:=substr(:donations.unit_id,1,13);
 Else

 End if;

 BEGIN

 SELECT note_id INTO noteid FROM donor_interdictions
 WHERE inter_code = :donations.inter_code
 and donor_id = :donations.donor_id
 and unit_id = szUnitId
 and nvl(originated_from,' ') = nvl(:donations.originated_from,' ')
 and nvl(reason_code,' ') = nvl(:donations.reason_code,' ')
 and nvl(group_id,' ') = nvl(:donations.group_id,' ')
 and nvl(group_mode,' ') = nvl(:donations.group_mode,' ')
 and transaction_id = :donations.transaction_id ;

 SELECT note 
 FROM central_notes
 WHERE note_id = noteid
 ORDER by note_id desc;
 BEGIN
 open C1;
 Fetch C1 INTO :donations.comments;
 END; 
 EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 BEGIN
 SELECT comments
 INTO :donations.comments
 FROM donation_interdictions
 WHERE inter_code = :donations.inter_code
 and unit_id = szUnitId
 and nvl(originated_from,' ') = nvl(:donations.originated_from,' ')
 and nvl(reason_code,' ') = nvl(:donations.reason_code,' ')
 and nvl(group_id,' ') = nvl(:donations.group_id,' ')
 and nvl(group_mode,' ') = nvl(:donations.group_mode,' ')
 and transaction_id = :donations.transaction_id ;

 END;
 END;
END;

 dri.originated_from, dri.reason_code, dri.group_id, dri.group_mode, 
 dri.eff_date, dri.insert_date, dri.term_date--, don.donation_type, don.procedure_code

 AND don.transaction_id = dri.transaction_id

 --- Added by Edwin for ISBT changes 05.14.2001

 -- Added By Edwin on 05.14.2001 for ISBT or CODABAR change
